name: Eventlocation Simulator
summary:
Build your own club. Run the night. Deal with the chaos.
Turn an empty venue into a thriving nightlife destination. Design your interiors, install lighting and sound systems, hire staff, stock the bar, serve drinks, and organize everything from club nights and concerts to poker tournaments, bot fights, and boxing events.
Outside your doors, explore a strange city filled with eccentric characters, side jobs, minigames, and secrets. Earn money, make questionable decisions, and try to keep your business—and yourself—in one piece.
